dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: You may have lost, but keep your chin up! Here! Have some hot soup!

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Congratulations! You won! Let's celebrate another victory with a feast!

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Hey there! Frozen to the bone? Come and warm yourself back up with some nice hot food!

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Whatever you're hungry for, just say the word. This weather's ripe for a piping-hot meal!

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: The name's Harris. I'm a chef and the person who built this camp.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: I came here to help the adventurers in the area, to make sure they can get a bowl of hot soup at the end of a long day of adventure.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: I reckon there's no greater joy than the feeling of hot soup in your system when you're just about frozen stiff.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: The essence of the culinary pursuit is to bring people satisfaction and joy, is it not?

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: It's a shame that lots of chefs have forgotten this... Personally, I was taught this simple principle by a young female chef who I met by chance while traveling in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Harris
dialogues.text: Sure! Remember, if you ever feel tired, you can always stop by to rest your feet and grab some grub!
